description_en: Creates a business process in DataStudio for data development
description_zh: 调用CreateBusiness，创建数据开发（DataStudio）的业务流程
name: CreateBusiness

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to view the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面查看ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier (workspace name) of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Configuration page to view the name.
You must specify either this parameter or projectId to determine the DataWorks project for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符（即工作空间名称）。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面查看名称。
该参数与projectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks项目
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The name of the business process. The name must be unique within the same workspace
parameters.help_zh: 业务流程名称，同一个项目空间下的业务流程名称必须唯一
parameters.name: business_name

parameters.example: This is a business process created through an interface.
parameters.help_en: The description of the business process
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the owner of the business process. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and hover over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the top navigation bar to view the account ID. If this parameter is left empty, the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the caller is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 业务流程对应责任人的阿里云账号ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，鼠标悬停至顶部菜单栏右侧的用户头像，查看账号ID。如果该参数为空，则默认使用调用者的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en:
The functional module to which the business process belongs. Valid values:
NORMAL: DataStudio.
MANUAL_BIZ: manual business process
parameters.help_zh:
业务流程所属的功能模块。取值如下：
NORMAL（数据开发）
MANUAL_BIZ（手动业务流程）
parameters.name: use_type

BusinessId.description_en: The ID of the business process

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
